steps.name: card-view-schema
steps.summary: supabase/migrations/20261018000000_card_views.sql·supabase/tests/card_views.test.sql 추가: card_summaries PK(user_id,card_id,period)와 복합 FK, save_card_summary(uuid,uuid,text,text,text,text,text,text[]) 결과(saved/card_not_found/basis_mismatch/no_data), update_card(uuid,uuid,text,text,integer) 결과(updated/not_found/invalid_label/duplicate_label), uploads_card_summaries(after delete, old.status='done'), pgTAP 82개 단언. dev DB 미적용(사용자 쪽에서 push·pgtap.sh 필요)
